events.head: List Day 0 and Day 1 card ids
events.input: $ grep -n -o -E 'id: "(start|d1)-[a-z0-9-]+",[^,]*title: "[^"]+"' app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | cut -c1-110 | head -60; grep -rln 'coverage.json' cloud/scripts app/scripts 2>/dev/null | head -3; python3 -c "
